$comment: Which rows of spec/docs/cheatsheet.md the syntax card in references/syntax.md was last read against. The card is the source that page is derived from, and a row keeps its construct token while its meaning is rewritten - so presence of the token proves nothing and the row is fingerprinted instead. Regenerate with `npm run spec:review` AFTER re-reading the rows the drift guard names - see README, "Not drifting".

Inline / row: `` !`/kaet/` ``.title: `` !`/kaet/` `` | /kaet/ | inline literal — verbatim prose, no `code` styling; `!` mirrors `$`-math

Inline / row: `[text][ref]`.title: `[text][ref]` | reference link | `[ref]: https://url` on its own line, anywhere

Inline / row: `[Page Name][]`.title: `[Page Name][]` | wiki-style link | resolves to a heading

Inline / row: `<https://url>`.title: `<https://url>` | autolink | bare URLs stay literal (autolinking them is Tier-2 opt-in)

Inline / row: `</#section-id>`.title: `</#section-id>` | cross-reference | link text cloned from the target

Inline / row: `[span]{.class}`.title: `[span]{.class}` | span | `{…}` adds class, id, or attributes

Inline / row: `:youtube[ID]` ✦.title: `:youtube[ID]` ✦ | extension | `:type[content]{attrs}` — syntax is core; the handler is opt-in

Inline / row: `--` `---` `...` `-->` `==.title: `--` `---` `...` `-->` `==>` `(c)` | – — … → ⇒ © | smart typography; a bare HYPHEN RUN with a space before it and a non-space after it is a CLI flag and stays literal (`x --next`) - the arrows are matched before that guard and still convert there (`x -->next` is `x →next`)
Inline / row: `--` `---` `...` `-->` `==.note: Re-measured 2026-08-28 on published `@markup-carve/carve` 0.1.5: the doubled family is now IN the release (`==>` renders U+21D2), and `=>` stopped converting in the same release. The row's ASCII spellings still render, so it stands; references/traps.md 12 carries the measurement and `doubled_arrows` in references/capabilities.json now probes it, which is what this note used to be doing by hand.

Inline / row: `{--}`.title: `{--}` | – | braced en dash — converts in the flag position the bare run refuses
Inline / row: `{--}`.note: Re-measured 2026-08-28: published `@markup-carve/carve` 0.1.5 renders `{--}` as the braced en dash, not an empty CriticMarkup delete. The reason this row was held back is gone; add it to the cheatsheet when someone re-reviews the row rather than silently here.

Inline / row: `\\` at end of line.title: `\` at end of line | hard break | `\ ` is a hard break here too — the trailing space is stripped before the escape is read

Inline / row: `\\ ` mid-line.title: `\ ` mid-line | no-break space | backslash-space; in the last column it is the hard break above
